reviews.author: Theresa Darley
reviews.text: I have been a satisfied customer of Any Season since 1985. They have provided sub terrain termite treatment and annual inspection with no recurrence of termite presence.

reviews.author: Mary Fernandez
reviews.text: Anthony came out this morning. He was professional and very kind. Explained everything expertly. I was very impressed with his demeanor and overall good vibes. Excellent service.

reviews.author: Clara Gee
reviews.text: I have been a customer for several years. The staff is very friendly and the technicians do an excellent job inside the house and outside. They keep my house pest free.

owner.name: Dick Orth
owner.text: Dick Orth has worked in the chemical industry for over 50 years after graduating from Trinity University with a BS degree in chemistry. Termites are Dick's specialty. In his words, "Any season in Houston is bug season."

summary: Termite, pest, rodent, flea, lawn pest and fire ant control for homes across the greater Houston area, from La Porte and Seabrook to Pearland and Manvel.

groups.title: Pest Control
groups.summary: Contract free general pest, rodent and flea treatments for your home, inside and out.
groups.intro: We offer contract free one time, bi-monthly, quarterly, semi-annual and annual treatments. General pest control comes with a 90 day warranty, and flea control comes with guaranteed control and a 60 day warranty.

services.title: General Pest Control
services.text: Contract free one time, bi-monthly, quarterly, semi-annual and annual treatments, with a 90 day warranty.
points: Ants, cockroaches, spiders, earwigs, pill and sowbugs
Hornets, wasps, beetles, flies, gnats, weevils and silverfish
90 day warranty, excluding German cockroaches, which is based on level of infestation

services.title: Mice and Rat Control
services.text: Baiting to eliminate your rodent problem, plus a thorough inspection of the home for entry points and conducive conditions for rodents.
points: Inspection for entry points and conducive conditions
Advice on how to control entry points in the future

services.title: Flea Control
services.text: A broadcast treatment of the home inside and out, including carpets, upholstery, grass and shrubbery.
points: Guaranteed control and a 60 day warranty
No warranty for outside only treatments

groups.title: Termites and Wood Destroyers
groups.summary: Complete control termite service with a 10 year warranty, plus control of other wood destroying insects.
groups.intro: With over 30 years of South Texas termite control experience, we are proud to provide a service of complete control that has a 10 year warranty. Termites are our founder's specialty.

services.title: Termite Control
services.text: Complete control with a 10 year warranty, covering indigenous subterranean, formosan, drywood and dampwood termites.
points: Most likely cases include indigenous and formosan subterranean termites

services.title: Other Wood Destroying Insects
services.text: Control of wood destroying beetles, carpenter ants and carpenter bees.

groups.title: Lawn and Fire Ants
groups.summary: Lawn pest and fire ant control for your yard, with a one year warranty on fire ant coverage.
groups.intro: Pests in the yard call for their own treatment. The best way to come up with a solution for lawn pests is to schedule an inspection, and our fire ant service covers your whole property.

services.title: Lawn Pest Control
services.text: Control of aphids, white scale, sod worms, chinch bugs, fleas and more. The best way to come up with a solution is to schedule an inspection.

services.title: Fire Ant Control
services.text: Complete coverage of your property, which includes a one year warranty.

about.title: Family owned and operated for over 35 years
text: Any Season Pest Control started in 1984 with one truck and our founder's wife in the office. Over time we gained enough customers to hire on a second truck, then a third, and his two daughters worked here for many years along with a few family friends.

We have grown from the Sagemont and Pearland area to servicing from La Porte, Seabrook and Texas City all the way to Manvel and Rosharon. After 35+ years of business we are embracing the new advances in treatment, advertising and communications.
Now going on three generations, his grandson Jacob has been with us for over 14 years and is ready to keep us growing. This company has and always will be family owned and operated.
